title: Netlify Build, Edge & Routing Diagnostics Ontology
description: Deterministic lint rules, triggers, and remediation patches enforced by Zoth Netlify AX & Serverless Edge Console v2.4.0.

rules.title: Circular or Self-Referential Redirect Loop
rules.trigger: ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS or multi-hop cycle in netlify.toml [[redirects]] or _redirects.
rules.root_cause: A rule redirects to itself (/a -> /a) or forms a cycle (/a -> /b -> /a).
rules.remediation: Remove self-referential rules and break cycles before deploy.

rules.title: Unreachable Redirect Shadowed by Earlier /* Splat
rules.trigger: Specific redirect rules placed after /* -> /index.html 200 never execute.
rules.root_cause: Netlify evaluates redirects top-to-bottom; an early /* catch-all intercepts all subsequent routes.
rules.remediation: Move all specific redirects and API proxies above the terminal /* -> /index.html 200 SPA rewrite.

rules.title: Missing or Misconfigured Publish Directory
rules.trigger: Netlify deploy error: Deploy directory does not exist.
rules.root_cause: [build] publish is unset or points to legacy public/ instead of Vite's dist/ output.
rules.remediation: Set [build] command = "npm run build" and publish = "dist" in netlify.toml.

rules.title: Unpinned Node.js Build Runtime
rules.trigger: Unsupported engine errors or unexpected runtime differences in CI builds.

rules.title: Missing Core Security or WebGPU COOP/COEP Headers
rules.trigger: Missing X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, CSP, or COOP/COEP on /*.
rules.root_cause: Global [[headers]] block omits defensive headers or SharedArrayBuffer isolation directives.
rules.remediation: Configure X-Frame-Options = "SAMEORIGIN", X-Content-Type-Options = "nosniff", Referrer-Policy = "strict-origin-when-cross-origin", CSP, COOP = "same-origin", and COEP = "credentialless" on /*.

rules.title: Plaintext Secret or Auth Token in Netlify Config
rules.trigger: Config contains NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN, nfp_, ghp_, sk_live_, AKIA, AIza, or PEM private key.
rules.root_cause: Sensitive credentials committed in netlify.toml or static assets instead of environment settings.
rules.remediation: Remove plaintext secret, rotate token, and configure via netlify env:set KEY VALUE.

rules.title: Missing SPA Catch-All Rewrite
rules.trigger: Direct reloads on client-routed paths return HTTP 404.
rules.root_cause: No terminal /* -> /index.html 200 rule in netlify.toml or _redirects.
rules.remediation: Add [[redirects]] from = "/*", to = "/index.html", status = 200 as the final redirect rule.

rules.title: Serverless Bundler or Edge Route Unconfigured
rules.trigger: Bloated Lambda bundles (>50 MB) or unrouted Edge Functions.
rules.remediation: Configure [functions] node_bundler = "esbuild" and map [[edge_functions]] routes explicitly.
